name: HFT Spreader 4 FORTS
summary: This is a high-frequency trading spreader EA designed for the FORTS (Russian derivatives) market. It places buy and sell limit orders on both sides of the order book when the spread is wide enough, and actively manages those orders by canceling and repositioning them as market conditions change. The strategy profits from capturing the spread by being the best bid and best offer in the order book.
summary_zh: 这是一个为FORTS（俄罗斯衍生品市场）设计的高频交易做市EA。当价差足够大时，它在订单簿两侧同时挂买入和卖出限价单，并随着市场条件变化主动管理和调整挂单位置。策略通过在订单簿中成为最优买卖价来赚取价差利润。
strategy_analysis: 策略概念：这是一个典型的做市（Market Making）策略，核心思想是在订单簿的买卖两侧同时挂单，通过赚取买卖价差获利。入场条件：当市场价差大于等于SpreadToPutOrders乘以最小变动价位时，在Ask下方一个最小变动价位挂卖限价单，在Bid上方一个最小变动价位挂买限价单，从而成为订单簿中的最优买卖价。出场条件：挂单被成交后，EA会在反方向挂出两倍成交量的限价单来平仓并重新开仓，形成连续做市循环。仓位管理：初始手数由Lots参数控制，成交后在反方向挂2倍量的限价单（一倍平仓、一倍反向开仓）。资金管理：没有止损止盈设置，也没有最大持仓限制，资金管理较为薄弱。订单管理：EA会持续监控挂单是否需要移动——如果挂单价格偏离当前最优价超过一个最小变动价位，或者当前挂单已成为订单簿中唯一的最优价且与次优价差距过大，就会删除并重新挂单。
strategy_analysis_en: Strategy concept: This is a classic market making strategy where the core idea is to simultaneously place orders on both sides of the order book to profit from the bid-ask spread. Entry conditions: When the market spread is greater than or equal to SpreadToPutOrders multiplied by the minimum tick size, the EA places a sell limit order one tick below the Ask and a buy limit order one tick above the Bid, effectively becoming the best bid and best offer in the order book. Exit conditions: After a pending order is filled, the EA places a limit order in the opposite direction at twice the filled volume—one lot to close the existing position and one lot to open a new position in the opposite direction, creating a continuous market-making cycle. Position sizing: Initial lot size is controlled by the Lots parameter, and upon fill, a 2x volume order is placed in the opposite direction (1x to close, 1x to reverse). Money management: There are no stop-loss or take-profit levels configured, and no maximum position limits, making money management quite weak. Order management: The EA continuously monitors whether pending orders need to be moved—if the order price deviates from the current best price by more than one tick, or if the order is the sole best price in the book with a large gap to the next level, it deletes and replaces the order.

parameters.name: Lots
parameters.description: 每次挂单的手数（交易量）

parameters.name: SpreadToPutOrders
parameters.description: 触发挂单的最小价差倍数（价差>=此值×最小变动价位时才挂单）
parameters.description_en: Min spread multiplier to trigger pending orders

parameters.name: Magic
parameters.description: EA的魔术编号，用于标识本EA的订单
parameters.description_en: Magic number for identifying EA orders

pros: 利用订单簿深度数据进行精细的做市策略，逻辑清晰
主动管理挂单位置，能够及时调整到最优买卖价，提高成交率
具有价差过滤机制，只在价差足够大时才挂单，避免在窄价差时被套
OnDeinit中自动平仓和删除挂单，确保EA移除时不会留下未管理的仓位
pros_en: Utilizes order book depth data for a refined market-making strategy with clear logic
Actively manages pending order positions, promptly adjusting to best bid/offer to improve fill rates
Includes a spread filter mechanism that only places orders when the spread is wide enough, avoiding being trapped in narrow spread conditions
Automatically closes positions and deletes pending orders in OnDeinit, ensuring no unmanaged positions remain when the EA is removed
cons: 没有止损和止盈设置，一旦单边行情出现可能造成重大亏损
2倍量反向挂单机制意味着每次成交后持仓量翻倍，存在仓位失控风险
isBestBidOrOfferOnlyMy函数中存在潜在的数组越界风险（访问book[index+1]或book[index-1]未做边界检查）
checkPriceInPendingOrder函数中OrderSelect后未使用pendingOrder.SelectByIndex或Select，导致pendingOrder对象可能未正确初始化
每次OnBookEvent中都创建新的CTrade对象删除订单，频繁创建销毁对象影响性能
cons_en: No stop-loss or take-profit configured, which can lead to significant losses during trending markets
The 2x volume reverse order mechanism means position size effectively doubles after each fill, creating a risk of uncontrolled position growth
Potential array out-of-bounds risk in isBestBidOrOfferOnlyMy function when accessing book[index+1] or book[index-1] without boundary checks
In checkPriceInPendingOrder, OrderSelect is called but the COrderInfo object is not properly initialized via Select/SelectByIndex, which may lead to incorrect data retrieval
Creating new CTrade objects on every OnBookEvent call for order deletion leads to unnecessary object creation/destruction overhead
improvements: 添加止损止盈机制和最大持仓限制，防止单边行情中的无限亏损
修复COrderInfo对象的初始化问题，确保OrderSelect后正确加载订单数据
对订单簿数组访问添加边界检查，防止越界崩溃
将CTrade对象改为全局或类成员变量，避免频繁创建销毁
添加持仓量递增的限制逻辑，避免2倍量反向挂单导致仓位失控
improvements_en: Add stop-loss, take-profit mechanisms and maximum position limits to prevent unlimited losses in trending markets
Fix COrderInfo initialization issue to ensure order data is properly loaded after OrderSelect
Add boundary checks for order book array access to prevent out-of-bounds crashes
Make CTrade a global or class member variable to avoid frequent object creation and destruction
Add position sizing limits to prevent the 2x volume reverse order mechanism from causing uncontrolled position growth

risk_points: 没有止损设置，单边行情可能导致巨大亏损
2倍量反向挂单机制可能导致持仓量指数级增长
订单簿数组访问缺乏边界检查，可能导致EA崩溃后持仓无人管理
COrderInfo对象初始化问题可能导致错误的交易决策
risk_points_en: No stop-loss configured, trending markets can cause massive losses
The 2x volume reverse order mechanism can lead to exponential position growth
Lack of boundary checks on order book array access can cause EA crashes leaving positions unmanaged
COrderInfo initialization issues may lead to incorrect trading decisions
